input.subject: Fee statement and admission confirmation – [PERSON_2], Student ID [STUDENT_ID_1]
input.body:
Dear Student Finance Team,

I am writing on behalf of the family of [PERSON_2], who we understand has been offered a place on the MSc programme starting January 2027 at Kingsgate University London, Student ID [STUDENT_ID_1].

Kinwarden is handling the payment of her fees on the family's behalf. Before any payment is made, we would be grateful if you could confirm in writing:

1. That [PERSON_2], Student ID [STUDENT_ID_1], is a confirmed applicant/student on the MSc programme commencing January 2027, and the offer reference if applicable.
2. The fee statement for the first instalment of tuition fees and for accommodation, showing the amount due, any deposit required, and the payment deadline.
3. Your bank details on official university letterhead (account name, account number, SWIFT/BIC, bank name and address).
4. The payment reference your bank requires so the funds are allocated to her account (we understand this is the Student ID).

If any part of the invoice will only be issued later (for example a final statement), please let us know when we should expect it.

Please reply to this email with the above. Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Kinwarden
On behalf of the family of [PERSON_2]
